title: Webhooks, HMAC signatures and idempotency
summary: How a backend knows a Shopify webhook is genuine, using a live SHA-256 and HMAC, why retries create duplicates, and how idempotency keys and transactions make each event count exactly once.

title: Retrieval and guardrails for an AI chatbot
summary: How the Curated Wellness chatbot blocks risky requests before the model, picks the right markdown chunks by shared words and boosts, packs them into a fixed budget, and checks the reply with rules in code.

title: Lighting uniformity and differential evolution
summary: How Sportslux works out the lux at every point of a field from a floodlight’s intensity table, scores a design on average light and uniformity, and searches 10^40 designs with differential evolution.

title: Bootstrap resampling of returns
summary: Why the wealth calculator samples real monthly history instead of a bell, how months compound into a year, and why it copies blocks of months, at the same dates for every fund.

title: Monte Carlo simulation and percentile bands
summary: How the wealth calculator turns one guess about returns into 500 random futures, how a seeded generator and the Box–Muller method draw each year’s return, and how percentiles turn the crowd into a band.

title: The unscented Kalman filter
summary: How sigma points carry a belief through a curve without a tangent, with each formula derived, and why that beats the extended filter on wide beliefs, as in the esports predictor.

title: The extended Kalman filter
summary: How the Kalman filter handles a measurement that bends, by working along the tangent at the best guess, with every formula derived from Pythagoras and the slope of the curve.

title: Hash tables and memoisation
summary: How remembering answers turns millions of repeated calls into dozens, how a hash table finds a stored answer instantly, how a chess position becomes a Zobrist key that every piece contributes to and every move edits, and how a transposition table applies it all.

title: Minimax and alpha-beta pruning
summary: How a chess engine picks a move by searching a game tree, and how alpha-beta pruning and move ordering skip most of the tree without changing the answer.

title: Sensor fusion: accelerometer and magnetometer
summary: How a drone works out roll and pitch from gravity, heading from the Earth’s magnetic field, and why it must combine the two, plus calibration and adding a gyroscope.

title: PID control
summary: How a drone uses proportional, integral and derivative terms to reach a target height and hold it, and why latency matters on a Raspberry Pi.

title: The Kalman filter
summary: How a filter combines a prediction with noisy measurements, with every formula derived: why variances add, the precision-weighted average, the Kalman gain and the new uncertainty.

title: O’Brien–Fleming boundaries
summary: How a clinical trial, or an A/B test of a new AI model, can check its results repeatedly and stop early without raising its 5% false positive risk. No statistics background needed.
